selection_rationale: Covers the main loudspeaker families found in French venues and schools. The French makers L-Acoustics (K2, Kara II, A15 Focus, KS28, X15 HiQ, X8) and NEXO (GEO M10, P12, 45N-12) are weighted heavily, alongside d&b (V8, V-SUB, Y10P), the main touring brands driven by external DSP amplifiers (LA12X, NXAMP, D80). Self-powered contrasts (Meyer LINA, RCF HDL 30-A), entry-level active boxes already in TekPractice (QSC K12.2, Yamaha DBR12) and two column systems (EV EVOLVE 50M G2, Bose L1 Pro32) cover the remaining wiring lessons: speakON NL4 pin usage (1+/1- vs 2+/2-), multi-way 8-point feeds, and XLR + powerCON daisy-chains.
